messages:
Maya (CS): FYI ACME go-live Thu 09:00 PST. They want streaming + aggressive client retries. Renewal check in ~6w, risk currently yellow. Can we put together a concise customer-facing runbook that covers: seed-cache prep, micro-batching settings, stream-handoff behavior, and a simple feedback capture flow for their PMs? @Ravi @Diego can you help draft the ops and runtime bullets?

Ravi (Eng): I'll draft a runtime checklist. High-level items: warm seed-cache with top prompts (200), set micro-batch window to 40ms (or 6-8 reqs), enable streaming with an explicit handoff to a full-response mode if streaming quality dips. Also include a short smoke test script.

Sofi (CS): Requesting enablement checkpoints: T-48h warm pool, T-4h smoke using prod keys with SE on call, T+24h feedback digest and T+7d triage. I'll own the digest. Add a one-question in-app rating after ~3 interactions.

Diego (SRE): From infra: reserve a warm pool for the tenant, temporary burst quota, circuit-breaker for long streams, and annotate metrics for the go-live window. Ops toggles example:
```
reserved_gpu_pool: acme-warm-01
burst_quota_multiplier: 2
circuit_break_timeout_s: 30
microbatch_window_ms: 40
seed_cache_file: acme_top200.csv
```

Noah (ACME): Agree on the single-tap rating. We'll provide the top-50 prompts by EOD — can you confirm how seed-cache is uploaded? Non-technical note for our ops team would be helpful.

Ravi (Eng): Seed-cache upload: control plane CSV upload (keys + canonical prompts). Micro-batch test: run `tools/sim_batch.sh --window 40 --concurrency 5`. Streaming handoff behavior (plain language): if partial streaming fails or slows, the system will send the rest of the reply at once so users still see an answer.

Sofi (CS): I'll create the customer-facing one-pager: checklist + brief plain-language fallbacks + feedback link (one-line rating that POSTs a transcript snippet to CS). I'll also coordinate invites for T-4h smoke.

Maya (CS): Renewal monitoring rule suggestion: track P95 latency, failed_stream_rate, and NPS mention score. If any two breach thresholds, auto-create an AMR item and schedule a focused workshop.

Diego (SRE): OpsBot: create reservation acme-warm-01 for 2026-03-26T08:30Z and enable burst_quota until 2026-03-26T13:00Z.

OpsBot: reservation created -> acme-warm-01 (id: rsv-1712). Burst quota enabled.

Ravi (Eng): Feedback webhook sketch for in-app rating:
```
POST /v1/feedback
{
  "tenant_id": "acme",
  "rating": 5,
  "snippet": "first user message + response (PII redacted)"
}
```
Receivers: cs-feedback Slack channel + CS digest job. Redact PII server-side.

Sofi (CS): I'll publish the T+24h digest and T+7d triage notes. Maya will publish the runbook link in the go-live announcement.

Maya (CS): Owners recap: Ravi -> runtime checklists & smoke scripts, Diego -> infra toggles & warm-pool, Sofi -> feedback digest & enablement schedule, Noah -> seed prompts. I'll assemble the runbook and share for review by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Noah (ACME): Thanks all. One small request: include a 2-line non-technical explanation of stream-handoff for our ops team.

Sofi (CS): Will add: "If streaming becomes unreliable, we switch to delivering the entire reply at once so the user still gets an answer without needing to reconnect."

Diego (SRE): Added observability note: annotate metrics with `tenant=acme,phase=go_live` for 48h to simplify dashboards.

Maya (CS): Thanks team — I'll post the doc link here when it's ready.
